set -euo pipefail
cd /tmp
echo "== ASE -> spglib -> phonopy: a chained materials workflow on bulk silicon =="
# ASE builds the crystal, spglib identifies its symmetry, phonopy USES that symmetry to
# reduce the displacement set and compute force constants. The identities validate the
# whole CHAIN, not three co-located tools: if spglib got the space group wrong, phonopy's
# symmetry reduction and force constants would be wrong and the acoustic modes would not
# vanish. Forces come from a generic Lennard-Jones field -- the acoustic-mode identity is
# a consequence of translational invariance (the acoustic sum rule), so it holds for ANY
# translationally-invariant potential; this validates the machinery and symmetry, not
# silicon's real phonon spectrum.
python3 - <<'EOF' > smoke-check.txt || { cat smoke-check.txt; exit 1; }
import sys, numpy as np, spglib
from ase.build import bulk
from ase import Atoms
from ase.calculators.lj import LennardJones
from phonopy import Phonopy
from phonopy.structure.atoms import PhonopyAtoms
fail=[]
def check(l,ok,detail):
    print(f"{l:26s} {detail}")
    if not ok: fail.append(l)

si = bulk("Si","diamond",a=5.43)
check("ase_unit_cell", len(si)==2, f"{len(si)}  want 2 (Si diamond primitive)")
# spglib space group -- exact-or-wrong
sg = spglib.get_spacegroup((si.cell[:], si.get_scaled_positions(), si.get_atomic_numbers()), symprec=1e-5)
check("spglib_spacegroup", sg=="Fd-3m (227)", f"{sg}  want Fd-3m (227)")

unit = PhonopyAtoms(symbols=si.get_chemical_symbols(), cell=si.cell[:], scaled_positions=si.get_scaled_positions())
ph = Phonopy(unit, supercell_matrix=np.eye(3)*2)
ph.generate_displacements(distance=0.03)
scs = ph.supercells_with_displacements
# spglib's symmetry cut the full 3N displacement set down to 1 unique displacement --
# the chain link made visible (2×2×2 supercell -> 1, only because Fd-3m was found)
check("symmetry_reduced_displacements", len(scs)==1, f"{len(scs)}  want 1 (spglib reduced the set)")
calc = LennardJones(sigma=2.0, epsilon=1.0, rc=6.0)
forces=[Atoms(symbols=s.symbols,cell=s.cell,scaled_positions=s.scaled_positions,pbc=True) for s in scs]
for a in forces: a.calc=calc
ph.forces=np.array([a.get_forces() for a in forces])
ph.produce_force_constants()
f=np.sort(np.abs(ph.get_frequencies([0,0,0])))   # 6 branches, |THz|
# acoustic sum rule: the 3 acoustic branches vanish at Gamma. Not exactly 0 -- a residual
# from finite displacement (0.03 A) and float precision; band 1e-2 THz is set by that
# (observed ~1e-6), not to pass. A broken chain gives THz-scale nonzero acoustic modes.
check("acoustic_modes_zero", max(f[:3])<1e-2, f"{max(f[:3]):.2e} THz  want < 1e-2 (3 acoustic -> 0 at Gamma)")
# optical modes at Gamma are triply degenerate for Si (T2g) -- a symmetry identity
opt=f[3:]; check("optical_degeneracy", (opt.max()-opt.min())<1e-3, f"spread {opt.max()-opt.min():.2e} THz  want < 1e-3 (3 optical degenerate)")
if fail: print("FAILED: "+", ".join(fail)); sys.exit(1)
EOF
cat smoke-check.txt
echo "SMOKE CHECK PASSED"
